blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Mission total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Mission West rose from 5 in June to 8 in September (+60.0%), and 2 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 6.6% of Mission’s 122 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Mission West?
Mission West also had 5 houses listed and 1 sold in September, against 8 condos and townhomes listed. The Mission West houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Mission West home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

9 townhomes sold in Mission West with a median price of $685,000 (the middle half sold between $675,000 and $692,000), taking a median of 14 days to sell at 98.8% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $473 per square foot, a median year built of 2022 and a median strata fee of $401 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Mission West?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 8 condos and townhomes listed in Mission West. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mission West a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Mission West had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Mission West from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 condos and townhomes sold in Mission West over those 4 months, out of 37 in all of Mission.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Mission West sell for?
faq.a: 9 townhomes sold in Mission West between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $685,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Mission West?
faq.a: The median was 14 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.8% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
